intro: HITAM and JNTUH both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded B.Tech fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.
HITAM vs JNTUH is not a single winner. HITAM is recorded as a private institute, while JNTUH is public. JNTUH holds a NIRF 2025 rank of 94; HITAM has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: HITAM vs JNTUH for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose JNTUH if you want a public B.Tech option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus.
Choose HITAM if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.
HITAM lists B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering, B.Tech Electrical & Electronics Engineering, B.Tech Electronics & Communication Engineering and more. JNTUH lists Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech).

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.
Our records list ₹1.3 lakh a year as total fees for HITAM's B.Tech Mechanical Engineering. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
Our records list ₹50,000 a year as tuition fees for JNTUH's Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech). Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for HITAM on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.
In our records, JNTUH's 2023 figures are an average of ₹8 lakh and a highest of ₹15 lakh for Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech). These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for HITAM on this B.Tech page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
JNTUH's recorded admission tests on this page include JEE Main.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, JNTUH is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
HITAM can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
